items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: No, I played with him already. ... I know Saeed. [INTERVIEWER] Saeed, he's a drummer. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: I don't know him too. You ever see him?

Yeah. He used to come and play, and I used to go down this name, Simon. He's a wino too. No, I played with him already. He'd been right around the corner yet some way. Simon Trajan. And he got another brother. He played his piano. What's your good? Good piano. Real good. I know Saeed.
